data.name: FetchHound
data.tagline: From human-canine to human-robot object search
data.description: Teaching a quadruped a dog-like social attention policy: 3D gaze and attention reconstructed from multi-camera dog video, closed-loop policies trained via learning from demonstration and evaluated on Spot in simulation.

data.name: UMBRA
data.kicker: Robotic Art · Supported by the National Endowment for the Arts
data.description: A fleet of SO-101 arms holds props under a single light to cast designed silhouettes: analytic pose solving, 5-DOF IK in MuJoCo, CMA-ES + JAX trajectory optimization, and a Next.js + FastAPI design studio, deployed to real hardware.
